name: The Incredible Miss Fortune
source:
A visual novel about a guy (Marley) who is turned into a girl with the goal of winning the cash prize at a beauty pageant.

[From [url=https://tfgames.site/index.php?module=viewgame&id=3284]TF Games Site[/url]]
translation:
这部视觉小说讲述一个名叫马利的小伙子的故事。为了赢得选美比赛的奖金，他被变成了女孩。
